absent: Layout and allocator behaviour for chain allocation, radix tree insertion and lookup, and image page acquisition policy.
Numeric values and units for bitmap blocking factors, linked page payload size, watchdog pacing, allocation flags, and sizing multipliers.
Locking, concurrency, and interrupt rules for global free, forbidden, and copy bitmaps and for preallocation counters.
Semantics of device power phases, system core suspend and resume, secondary CPU control, wakeup pending and event checks, and platform operation tables.
Console object layout, flag values, list and SRCU protection details, flush types, deferred output, and logger wakeup behaviour.
True swap signature handling beyond the fallback no-op, and low level valid and enter callbacks for standby and memory states.
Error origin and recovery obligations for firmware begin, prepare, enter, recover, finish, and end plus suspend again polling.

findings.text: Snapshot helpers visible outside their file estimate bookkeeping overhead and manipulate global page maps. The sizing helper derives an estimate from a zone extent and blocking factors. The free and forbidden map helpers clear or test membership by frame number only when the corresponding global map exists, otherwise doing nothing or reporting clear.

Power and console coordination helpers are globally callable. Console suspend and resume bracket device power transitions. Device suspend plus enter drives one full suspend and resume cycle for a requested sleep target. Platform hibernate enter drives firmware assisted hibernation with full device and CPU coordination.

A page is saveable only after passing a sequence of exclusions. Invalid frame numbers, offline pages, pages belonging to another zone, forbidden or free pages, guard pages, offline markers, and high versus low class mismatches are rejected. Reserved low pages are further rejected when not present in the kernel mapping or when marked no-save.

Bitmap and image page release follow strict pairing. Clearing a bit assumes the frame lookup succeeds. Releasing an image page requires a valid address, clears forbidden membership and optionally free membership, then releases the page. Bitmap teardown releases both node and leaf storage plus a chained page list, then reinitializes the zone list.

Frame range extents form a sorted merged list covering populated zones. Each zone either inserts a new disjoint extent or extends an overlapping one, followed by absorption of further overlapped successors. Allocation failure releases the whole partial list and reports resource exhaustion. Explicit teardown unlinks and releases every element safely during traversal.

Image preallocation keeps counters and a copy bitmap consistent. Each successful page allocation marks the page forbidden and free, records the frame in the copy bitmap, and increments the matching high or normal counter. Normal allocation is capped by remaining need and available normal pages. High allocation is either proportional or disabled by build variant. Surplus trimming recounts saveable pages and releases frames while clearing maps and decrementing counters. Minimum size subtracts global reclaimable and active plus inactive anonymous and file occupancy with a floor at zero.

Free page marking holds one zone lock with interrupt state saved across the entire scan of valid frames and free lists, clearing stale free marks for non-forbidden pages and setting free marks for buddy members, with periodic watchdog service. The lock is released only after both scans complete.

Suspend to idle entry serializes wakeup observation and state publication with a dedicated raw spin lock held with interrupts disabled. The pending check and transition to enter state occur atomically under the lock, the lock is dropped while waiting for wake state, and reacquired to publish the none state. Correctness depends on a stable online CPU set during the wait.

Console power transitions update per-console suspended state under a console list lock and then wait for SRCU readers to complete, so every printing context observes the new suspended or resumed state before the caller proceeds. Resume additionally gates deferred output and logger wakeups on the resulting flush type.

Snapshot bookkeeping uses several linked layouts. A tree node carries image page storage plus list linkage. A zone tree carries separate lists for interior nodes and leaves. A bitmap carries a list of zone trees plus a singly chained page list linked through a next field. A memory extent carries a start frame, an end frame, and a hook for list membership.

Device suspend plus enter follows validate, record target, begin platform, suspend consoles, start device suspend, test point, repeated enter attempts until error or wakeup or no repeat request, then resume devices, resume consoles, end platform, and reset target to on. Device suspend failure diverts through platform recovery before the shared resume path.

Low level suspend enter advances through platform prepare, late device suspend, late platform prepare, no-interrupt device suspend, no-interrupt platform prepare, platform test, then either an idle loop or secondary CPU shutdown with interrupts disabled, system suspend marking, core suspend, wakeup check, and machine enter. Each failure unwinds through mirrored resume and finish stages in reverse order.

Firmware hibernation enter advances through firmware begin, console suspend, device suspend start and end, firmware prepare, secondary CPU shutdown, interrupt disable, system suspend marking, core suspend, wakeup check, and firmware enter which does not return on success. Failures unwind through core resume, interrupt enable, CPU enable, firmware finish, device resume start and end, console resume, and firmware end.

Power down after image creation prefers a suspend transition when configured, falling back to platform, shutdown, and halt behaviours on failure. Platform wakeup indications during hibernation trigger rollback and swap signature restoration. If power off does not take effect the control flow ends in a halt loop after requesting manual power down.

Suspend to idle alternates between observation and entry. The outer loop breaks on platform wake indication or generic pending wakeup, otherwise runs an optional platform check and enters. Entry publishes an enter state, pushes all processors into idle, waits exclusively for a wake state, kicks processors to restore timers, and finally publishes the none state.

The main suspend entry point requires a supported sleep target, records it as the current target, and returns platform or device errors to the caller after restoring consoles, devices, platform state, and target. It emits trace events around console resume and supports repeated enter attempts requested by the platform.

The firmware hibernation entry point requires a registered hibernation operation table and reports unsupported when absent. It returns begin, device, prepare, CPU, interrupt, core, wakeup, or enter failures after running the matching unwind and firmware end step.

Tree node allocation can leak its first allocation when image page acquisition fails, because the observed failure path returns without releasing the node container. Zone tree teardown releases page storage for nodes and leaves but the fragments show no release of the node containers themselves. Bitmap clearing treats lookup failure as fatal.

Hibernation and power down contain non returning paths. Firmware enter is followed by an infinite wait that is only left by firmware control transfer. Final power down ends in an infinite relax loop after requesting manual action, and swap usability depends on successful signature restoration on the rollback path.

Power control distinguishes hibernation behaviours for suspend, reboot, platform, and shutdown, suspend targets for idle, standby, and memory plus an on target, system phases for running and suspend, idle entry states for none, enter, and wake, power message tags for hibernate, suspend, restore, and resume, and negative results for unsupported operation, busy, retry, and resource exhaustion.

Suspend testing distinguishes device, platform, processor, and core test levels with a configurable delay, and snapshot sizing depends on block, entry, linked page data size, and watchdog pacing parameters whose numeric values are not shown in these fragments.
